desc: Write code to parse input and store bad intervals.
Generate critical points: 1, N, and all $R_i+1 \le N$. Sort and unique them.
Precompute `can_reach` array up to 2000 and find threshold $T$ for large jumps.
Assign segment IDs to each critical point based on bad intervals.
Build adjacency list for the graph: for each pair of points in the same segment, if the distance is representable, add an edge.
Run BFS from the node for square 1 to check if the node for square N is reachable.
Print "Yes" or "No" based on BFS result.
